name: @paste2prompt/element
description: paste2prompt as an overlay for any web page: a launcher button, a page capture and the editor, in a web component.

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && node build.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.demo: node build.mjs --demo && echo "Serve the repo root (python3 -m http.server) and open /packages/element/demo/"
